description: This file declares APIs and data structures related to neighbor discovery, specifically for network interface settings and neighbor discovery parameters. It includes function prototypes for getting, setting, validating, committing, and rolling back neighbor discovery configurations, as well as managing interface-specific neighbor discovery settings.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_GetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Retrieves the boolean value of a specified neighbor discovery parameter.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_GetParamIntValue
methods.description: Retrieves the integer value of a specified neighbor discovery parameter.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_GetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Retrieves the unsigned long value of a specified neighbor discovery parameter.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_GetParamStringValue
methods.description: Retrieves the string value of a specified neighbor discovery parameter.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_SetParamBoolValue
methods.description: Sets the boolean value of a specified neighbor discovery parameter.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_SetParamIntValue
methods.description: Sets the integer value of a specified neighbor discovery parameter.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_SetParamUlongValue
methods.description: Sets the unsigned long value of a specified neighbor discovery parameter.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_SetParamStringValue
methods.description: Sets the string value of a specified neighbor discovery parameter.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_Validate
methods.description: Validates neighbor discovery parameters before applying changes.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_Commit
methods.description: Commits changes to neighbor discovery settings.

methods.name: NeighborDiscovery_Rollback
methods.description: Rolls back any uncommitted changes to neighbor discovery settings.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting2_GetEntryCount
methods.description: Returns the count of interface neighbor discovery settings entries.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting2_GetEntry
methods.description: Retrieves a specific interface neighbor discovery setting entry by index.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting2_AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new interface neighbor discovery setting entry.

methods.name: InterfaceSetting2_DelEntry
methods.description: Deletes a specified interface neighbor discovery setting entry.
